Bill.BriefDescription: Creating incentives for the use of biomass in renewable energy production.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating incentives for the use of biomass inrenewable energy production; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, harvesters areallowed a credit against the amount of tax otherwise due under thischapter, as provided in this section. The credit is thirty dollars perharvested green ton of forest derived biomass sold, transferred, orused for production of electricity, steam, heat, or biofuel. Creditmay not be claimed for forest derived biomass sold, transferred, orused before the effective date of this section. The amount of creditallowed for a reporting period may not exceed the tax otherwise dueunder this chapter for that reporting period. Any unused excesscredit in a reporting period may be carried forward to future reportingperiods for a maximum of two years. p. 1 SSB 5441 (2) For the purposes of this section, "harvested" and "harvesters"are defined in RCW 84.33.035, and "biofuel" is defined in RCW43.325.010.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales offorest derived biomass used to produce electricity, steam, heat, orbiofuel. This exemption is available only if the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (2) For purposes of this section, "biofuel" is defined in RCW43.325.010.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of forest derived biomass for production of electricity, steam,heat, or biofuel. (2) For purposes of this section, "biofuel" is defined in RCW43.325.010.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
Sections 1 through 3 of this act take effectOctober 1, 2009.
